text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...! I lost...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...I couldn't live up to
everyone's expectations...
choice_data_list: Even so, you ran a great race.
Even so, you ran really well.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I couldn't win.
That's all there is to it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I heard sighs of disappointment.
I... I just...

...Oguri Cap doesn't move.
That was just how bitter
this defeat was for her.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Great work out there, Oguri-chan.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I won this time.
Do you intend... to end it here?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...I didn't mean to...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Then you must look forward.
I will be waiting just up ahead.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
And I'll be taking the win next time too.
You'd better brace yourself, okay?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...I won't lose anymore.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"I'll get even stronger,
and beat Creek next time for sure...!"

Whether ignited by Super Creek's words or not, Oguri Cap was already looking forward.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
I... want to become even stronger!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Creek said she'd be waiting a little further ahead.
...She must mean next year's Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Then there is no way I can sit this out.
...And this time, I will win."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to let everyone down
ever again...!

Oguri Cap currently has plenty of ability.
In that case, what she needs next might be gaining
experience in GⅠ races.

Polishing her skills in GⅠ races packed with formidable rivals.
The experience cultivated there will surely
help her grow even further.
choice_data_list: Alright, let's enter lots of races!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

Oguri Cap is fully fired up!
Just as the two of us were about to discuss our strategy for the next race—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Coming in!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I watched ya closely right from the start~
Good work out there!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I saw how hard ya worked!
You ran great, seriously, thank you for your hard work!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...!
Thank you, Tama—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Whoops...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wait, are you okay?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, I'm fine.
I just felt a bit weak for a moment...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it's because she saw Tama's face.
She seems to feel a little relieved.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...
What's up with that?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Tama?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey, am I yer mother or somethin'?
'Cause I ain't, right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I'm an Umamusume too, ya know!
Did ya forget that or somethin'!?"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Huh... N-No, I haven't forgotten.
After all, Tama, you're definitely an Umamusume, right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh, don't take it so literally!
What I'm tryin' to say is!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: —That means I'm your rival too!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...I've decided, right here and now!
I'm gonna fight ya!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...To tell the truth, I was plannin'
to challenge the Dream Trophy
startin' next year, but.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Huh...

—The "Dream Trophy League."
A higher-level league where Umamusume who made their mark in the Twinkle Series compete.

Tamamo Cross, who debuted a bit earlier than Oguri Cap,
would normally have naturally aimed for that very stage.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you race Creek made up my mind.
I'm staying one more year to beat you!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Let's settle who's on top.
Me, Creek, or you!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, Oguri.
—Your next opponent is gonna be me!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...It's fine.
Now, let's make our next plan.

Although the battle with Super Creek was over,
yet another formidable rival appeared before Oguri Cap.

Oguri Cap looked somewhat downcast.
And thus, a period of trials began for her...!
